candidates.sentence: We need a tax code that will generate domestic economic growth while we also enact legislation to open new markets around the world for American made products.
I support legislation to fix the tax code with common sense changes that ensure everyone pays their fair share and families have less of a tax burden.
As a former school board member, I know first-hand that spending massive amounts of money on education does not always lead to positive results.
Congress must find ways to reduce the taxes that individuals pay while ensuring that the government is fiscally accountable for how we spend tax revenue.
I believe that the tax code should be simpler, taxes should be lower, and that the federal government needs to be careful not to pick winners and losers.
